copy.title: The Zuckerberg Money File
copy.desc: An interactive, fully sourced map of Mark Zuckerberg’s family: who owns what, which stocks you can buy, the homes, and the money on the public record.
copy.eyebrow: File #008 · The Zuckerberg family · Data as of
copy.h1: The $1-a-year CEO has a family. We followed the money.
copy.lede: Who’s who, what each of them owns, which of their companies you can buy stock in, the homes, and the money on the public record. Every number links to its source.
copy.familyLede: Tap anyone to open their file: what they own, what’s on the record, and where every fact comes from. Mark and Priscilla’s daughters appear by first name only.
copy.investLede: One family company trades on the stock market: Meta. The rest are private.
copy.moneyLede: The fortune comes from Facebook, now Meta. Only Mark has a published net worth.
copy.homesTitle: More than half a billion dollars in homes and land

copy.homesFlipLabel: Homes and land, by our math
copy.recordLede: The money that shows up in SEC filings, the giving pledge and the home purchases. Filings and reporting, not guesses.
copy.trailLede: From a student website in 2004 to the sixth-biggest fortune on Earth.

summary.t: Joined Facebook in 2005 as one of its first dozen employees. Left in 2011 as director of market development and a spokesperson, and founded Zuckerberg Media that year.

owns.t: Founded it in 2011. It has made shows and digital content for clients including the United Nations, Condé Nast and Bravo.

facts.t: Wrote Dot Complicated (2013) and Pick Three (2018), and voiced “Ms. Randi” on the animated series Dot.
Hosts a weekly business show on SiriusXM and co-founded the online art community HUG in 2022.

summary.t: Started Facebook in 2004, at 19, and still runs it as Meta’s founder, chairman and CEO. He owns about 13% of the company and controls a majority of its votes.

owns.t: Owns about 13% of the stock. Because he controls a majority of the votes, Meta is a “controlled company” under Nasdaq rules.
Co-founded it with Priscilla in 2015, set up as a limited liability company rather than a charitable trust. They pledged to give away 99% of their shares over their lifetimes.

record.t: Meta’s 2026 proxy says his base salary is $1 a year, with no bonus or stock awards. Meta also pays for his security program.
Meta paid about $2.2 million in 2025 to charter private planes he indirectly owns, for his business travel.

Said he would sell 35 million to 75 million Facebook shares over 18 months, then worth $6 billion to $12.8 billion, to fund his and Priscilla’s giving. Facebook dropped a plan for new non-voting shares after investors sued.
Meta shares sold on Sept 24, 2026 by his CZI Holdings and by Chan Zuckerberg Biohub went through trading plans adopted Jan 31, 2026, an SEC filing shows.

facts.t: At about 11, he wrote ZuckNet, a program that linked computers in the family home with his father’s dental office.
His Class B shares are held through his 2006 trust and a series of Chan Zuckerberg holding companies, per a September 2026 SEC filing.
Forbes says he and Priscilla are spending $3 billion to try to end, cure or manage all disease by 2100.
He and Priscilla paid $170 million for a compound on Miami’s Indian Creek Island in 2026, a Miami-Dade County record.

kidsNote.t: Mark and Priscilla have three daughters. We list them by first name only.

summary.t: Pediatrician and the co-founder and co-CEO of the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, where she runs day-to-day operations. Her parents were ethnic Chinese refugees from Vietnam.

worth.none: No published estimate of her own.

owns.t: Co-founder and co-CEO. CZI started in December 2015.

record.t: She and Mark pledged in 2015 to give away 99% of their Facebook shares over their lifetimes, then worth about $45 billion.
She and Mark gave $75 million to San Francisco General Hospital, where she worked as a pediatrician until 2017. It is now Zuckerberg San Francisco General Hospital and Trauma Center.

facts.t: Met Mark at Harvard in 2003 and married him on May 19, 2012, the day after Facebook went public.
Co-founded The Primary School, a free school with health services, in 2016. CZI said in April 2025 it would close the school’s East Palo Alto and San Leandro campuses after the 2025–26 school year.

summary.t: A dentist. He and Karen raised Mark and his three sisters in Dobbs Ferry, New York.

facts.t: When Mark was about 11, he wrote ZuckNet, which let computers in the family home talk to Edward’s dental office.

summary.t: A psychiatrist, born Karen Kempner. She and Edward raised their four children in Dobbs Ferry, New York.
Classics scholar with a PhD from Princeton. She founded and edited Eidolon, an online classics journal that closed in 2020.

facts.t: Wrote Not All Dead White Men: Classics and Misogyny in the Digital Age (Harvard University Press, 2018).

summary.t: The youngest of the four siblings. A former Google product manager, she joined the venture firm Kleiner Perkins in 2015. People reported in 2025 that she was a general partner at Long Journey Ventures.

facts.t: Named to the Forbes 30 Under 30 list in 2019.
